title: LDOS 5.3.1 double density (complete system)
description: LDOS on a 180 KB double-density disk (Radio Shack doubler, track 0 single density to boot), with the files of both LDOS disks: help (HELP DIR), BASIC, utilities. Made in this emulator with LDOS itself (FDUBL, FORMAT, BACKUP, SYSGEN, SOLE). At boot, enter a date from its era, e.g. 10/08/91.
